faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is there a daily mileage limit, and what if I exceed it?
faq.a1: Standard daily mileage limit is 250 km. Additional kilometers are calculated at a nominal rate specified in your contract.
faq.q2: Can I drive the rental car outside Baku?
faq.a2: Yes! You can drive anywhere within Azerbaijan. Just notify us if you plan long regional trips.
faq.q3: Can I take the rental car outside Azerbaijan?
faq.a3: Cross-border travel requires prior written authorization and special international insurance arrangements.
faq.q4: How are tolls handled on a rental car?
faq.a4: Tolls are automatically logged and settled upon vehicle return or deducted from the final invoice.
faq.q5: Can I book a car for the same day or on short notice?
faq.a5: Yes, we offer instant same-day bookings with quick delivery across Baku within 60 minutes.
faq.q6: Can I pay in instalments or Buy Now, Pay Later?
faq.a6: We accept major credit/debit cards, cash, bank transfers, and flexible payment plans for long-term rentals.
faq.q7: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
faq.a7: Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before your scheduled pickup time with 100% refund.
faq.q8: Is there a minimum rental period?
faq.a8: The minimum rental duration is 1 day (24 hours).
faq.q9: What valid documents do I need to rent a car?
faq.a9: You need a valid Passport / ID card and a valid Driving License.
faq.q10: Do I need an international driving license in Baku?
faq.a10: If your license is in English or Roman script, it is accepted. Otherwise, an International Driving Permit (IDP) is required.
faq.q11: Can I rent a car if I am under 21?
faq.a11: Minimum age requirement is 21 years old with at least 1 year of driving experience.
faq.q12: What should I do if I have an accident or breakdown?
faq.a12: Contact our 24/7 support immediately and report to local traffic police for an official report.
faq.q13: Is full or zero-excess insurance coverage available?
faq.a13: Yes, full comprehensive collision damage waiver (CDW) with zero excess is available as an add-on.
faq.a14: Yes, emergency roadside assistance is available 24/7 across all regions of Baku and Azerbaijan.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about renting a car with Royal Baku Rent A Car in Baku & Azerbaijan.
faqPage.res1Q: How do I book a car with Royal Baku Rent A Car?
faqPage.res1A: You can book directly via WhatsApp (+971 55 107 3595 / +994 50 123 4567), call our 24/7 concierge, or submit an instant booking request on our website.
faqPage.res2Q: Can I book online, or only via WhatsApp/call?
faqPage.res2A: Both! Online web bookings, WhatsApp messaging, and direct calls are processed immediately by our concierge team.
faqPage.res3Q: Can I book a car for the same day or on short notice?
faqPage.res3A: Yes, we specialize in instant same-day doorstep and Heydar Aliyev Airport delivery within 30-60 minutes.
faqPage.res4Q: How early should I book during peak season or events?
faqPage.res4A: During Formula 1 Baku GP, Formula races, or summer holiday seasons, we recommend booking 3 to 7 days in advance for hypercar availability.
faqPage.res5Q: Do I need to pay a deposit to book?
faqPage.res5A: A standard refundable security deposit of $100 is required for all vehicle rentals, fully refunded within 10 business days after returning the vehicle.
faqPage.res6Q: Can I change my booking dates after confirming?
faqPage.res6A: Yes, booking dates can be modified free of charge up to 24 hours prior to scheduled pickup.
faqPage.price1Q: Are your rental prices inclusive of VAT?
faqPage.price1A: Yes, all published rental prices are 100% transparent and inclusive of all applicable taxes and VAT.
faqPage.price2Q: Do prices change based on rental duration?
faqPage.price2A: Yes, we offer discounted rates for weekly (7+ days) and monthly (30+ days) rental commitments.
faqPage.price3Q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqPage.price3A: We accept Credit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX), Cash (AZN, USD, EUR, AED)
faqPage.price4Q: Are there any hidden charges I should know about?
faqPage.price4A: Never! All insurance, taxes, and daily mileage allowances are clearly detailed upfront with zero hidden fees.
faqPage.price5Q: Can I pay in installments or use Buy Now, Pay Later?
faqPage.price5A: Yes, installment plans are available through supported credit card providers for long-term rentals.
faqPage.price7Q: Is there a security deposit on rentals?
faqPage.price7A: A standard refundable security deposit of $100 applies to every car rental, refunded within 10 business days upon vehicle return.
faqPage.cancel1A: Free cancellation is provided up to 24 hours before your scheduled vehicle delivery.
faqPage.cancel2Q: What happens if I need to shorten or extend my rental?
faqPage.cancel2A: You can extend your rental anytime via WhatsApp. Early returns are recalculated according to daily rental terms.
faqPage.cancel3Q: Can I get a refund if I cancel my booking?
faqPage.cancel3A: Full refunds are issued for cancellations requested at least 24 hours in advance.
faqPage.cancel4Q: Is there a minimum rental period?
faqPage.cancel4A: Our minimum rental duration is 1 day (24 hours).
faqPage.lic1Q: Can I rent a car in Baku with a foreign driving license?
faqPage.lic1A: Yes! Drivers with valid home country driving licenses from GCC, Europe, US, UK, Canada, and Australia can rent directly.
faqPage.lic2Q: What documents do I need to rent a car in Baku?
faqPage.lic2A: Tourists require a Passport, Home Country Driving License, and International Driving Permit (if applicable). Residents require National ID and Driver License.
faqPage.lic3Q: Do I need an International Driving Permit (IDP) to rent a car?
faqPage.lic3A: IDP is only required if your original driving license is not printed in English or Roman script.
faqPage.lic4Q: Can tourists rent a car in Baku?
faqPage.lic4A: Yes, tourists can easily rent and drive our vehicles across Azerbaijan.
faqPage.lic5Q: Can I rent a car if I'm under 25?
faqPage.lic5A: Drivers aged 18 to 24 can rent selected luxury and economy vehicles with standard insurance terms.
faqPage.lic6Q: Is residency required to rent a car?
faqPage.lic6A: No, local residency is not required. International visitors are fully welcome.
faqPage.mil1Q: Is there a daily mileage limit, and what if I exceed it?
faqPage.mil1A: Standard daily allowance is 250 - 300 km/day. Additional mileage is charged at nominal rates (3 - 25 AZN/km depending on vehicle category).
faqPage.mil2Q: Can I take the rental car outside Baku or across regions?
faqPage.mil2A: Yes, all our vehicles can be driven across all cities and regions of Azerbaijan (Ganja, Qabala, Shahdag, etc.).
faqPage.mil3Q: Can I drive the rental car to regional Azerbaijan cities?
faqPage.mil3A: Absolutely! Doorstep delivery and pickup are available in all major Azerbaijan regions.
faqPage.mil4Q: How are traffic fines and tolls handled on a rental car?
faqPage.mil4A: Traffic fines and electronic tolls are tracked automatically and settled upon return or billed transparently.
faqPage.ins1Q: Is insurance included in the rental price?
faqPage.ins1A: Yes, comprehensive basic motor insurance is included in every rental package.
faqPage.ins2Q: Is full or zero-excess insurance (CDW) available?
faqPage.ins2A: Yes, Super Collision Damage Waiver (SCDW) zero-excess insurance upgrades can be added upon booking.
faqPage.ins3Q: What should I do if I have an accident or breakdown?
faqPage.ins3A: Contact our 24/7 emergency hotline immediately. Our concierge handles police reports, vehicle replacement, and roadside service.
faqPage.ins4A: Yes, 24/7 roadside assistance, towing, and replacement vehicle services are guaranteed nationwide.
